technology.name: Aarogya Setu
technology.description: Aarogya Setu, a COVID-19 contact-tracing, syndromic-mapping and self-assessment app for Android and iOS, was launched on 2 April 2020; its website credits the National Informatics Centre and the IT ministry, though both said in an RTI reply in October 2020 that they did not know who had developed it.

technology.name: Covaxin
technology.description: Covaxin (BBV152), a whole inactivated virus vaccine, was developed by Bharat Biotech in collaboration with the Indian Council of Medical Research and the National Institute of Virology.

technology.name: Online chess Olympiad
technology.description: India and Russia shared gold at the online Olympiad, held between 24 July and 30 August 2020 on Chess.com; Viswanathan Anand, Vidit Gujrathi, Koneru Humpy and Harika Dronavalli were in India's team.
